meta.name: AURORA 技术知识库
meta.description: 本地常见 Windows 事件日志诊断与解决方案库 - 增强版 v4.0 - 扩充至 200+ 条规则，覆盖 10 大类别（含性能问题诊断）
meta.description_en: Local common Windows event log diagnosis and solution library - Enhanced v4.0 - Expanded to 200+ rules covering 10 categories (including Performance Issues)

items.name: 意外关机/内核电源错误
items.description: 系统在没有正常关闭的情况下重新启动。
items.description_en: The system restarted without properly shutting down.
causes: 驱动程序崩溃导致蓝屏后自动重启
causes_en: Automatic restart after blue screen due to driver crash
Fake Event 41 caused by Windows Fast Startup
solutions: 检查机箱内部灰尘和风扇运转情况
运行 'sfc /scannow' 修复系统文件
查看 Windows 可靠性监视器中的蓝屏代码以定位具体驱动
关闭 Windows 快速启动 (Fast Startup)
检查电源 (PSU) 额定功率是否满足峰值负载，以及是否存在电容老化
solutions_en: Check internal case dust and fan operation
Check blue screen codes in Windows Reliability Monitor to identify specific drivers
Check if power supply (PSU) wattage meets peak load and for capacitor aging
items.recommended_action: 立即检查系统硬件和电源状态
items.recommended_action_en: Immediately check system hardware and power status

commands.name: 运行DISM修复系统映像
commands.name_en: Run DISM to Repair System Image

commands.name: 检查系统温度(如安装OpenHardwareMonitor)
commands.command: Get-CimInstance -Namespace root\OpenHardwareMonitor -ClassName Sensor | Where-Object {$_.SensorType -eq 'Temperature'} | Select-Object Name, Value

items.name: 蓝屏转储
items.description: 系统发生蓝屏错误，生成了内存转储文件
items.description_en: The system encountered a blue screen error and generated a memory dump file
solutions: 分析蓝屏代码确定具体原因
提取.dmp文件进行轻量级分析
solutions_en: Analyze blue screen code to determine specific cause
items.recommended_action: 分析转储文件并解决根本原因
items.recommended_action_en: Analyze dump files and resolve the root cause

commands.name: 运行Windows内存诊断
commands.pre_check: Write-Warning 'mdsched.exe将调度下次重启进入内存诊断模式，请先保存所有工作'; $true

commands.name: 查询驱动验证程序状态

items.name: 程序崩溃
items.description: 应用程序意外终止，可能是由于软件 bug 或资源问题
items.description_en: Application terminated unexpectedly, possibly due to software bugs or resource issues
causes: 第三方 DLL 注入（如输入法、防病毒软件）
solutions: 更新应用程序到最新版本
检查系统内存使用情况
重新安装有问题的应用程序
在事件日志中提取 Faulting module name (错误模块路径)
solutions_en: Update application to the latest version
Extract Faulting module name (error module path) in event logs
items.recommended_action: 更新应用程序并检查系统资源
items.recommended_action_en: Update applications and check system resources

commands.name: 查看应用程序崩溃事件
清理应用程序临时文件

items.name: 托管代码异常
items.description: .NET 应用程序发生未处理的异常
items.description_en: .NET application encountered an unhandled exception
solutions: 增加应用程序内存限制
items.recommended_action: 更新 .NET Framework 并检查应用程序代码
items.recommended_action_en: Update .NET Framework and check application code

commands.name: 检查已安装的.NET版本
commands.command: Get-ChildItem 'HKLM:\SOFTWARE\Microsoft\NET Framework Setup\NDP' -Recurse | Get-ItemProperty -Name Release,Version -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Where-Object { $_.PSChildName -match '^(?!S)\p{L}'} | Select-Object PSChildName, Version, Release

items.name: 磁盘错误
items.description: 磁盘硬件错误
items.description_en: Disk hardware error
solutions: 优先读取 S.M.A.R.T. 健康数据，确认无严重物理故障后再执行磁盘扫描
solutions_en: First read S.M.A.R.T. health data, confirm no serious physical failure before running disk scan
items.recommended_action: 立即检查SMART数据并备份数据
items.recommended_action_en: Immediately check SMART data and backup data

commands.name: 检查磁盘健康状态
commands.command: Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object DeviceId, FriendlyName, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus, Size

commands.name: 获取SMART健康信息
commands.command: Get-PhysicalDisk | Get-StorageReliabilityCounter | Select-Object DeviceId, Temperature, ReadErrorsTotal, WriteErrorsTotal

commands.name: 运行CHKDSK检查C盘(警告:物理损坏时可能有风险)
commands.name_en: Run CHKDSK on C Drive (Warning: Risky with physical damage)
commands.note: 需要重启才能完成；物理损坏时可能增加数据风险

items.name: 上次关机非正常
items.description: 系统上次关机是非正常的
items.description_en: The system's last shutdown was unexpected
items.recommended_action: 检查电源稳定性并解决导致崩溃的问题
items.recommended_action_en: Check power stability and resolve crash issues

commands.name: 查看系统启动/关闭历史
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ID=1074,6005,6006,6008} -MaxEvents 30 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 系统启动缓慢
items.description: 系统启动时间过长
items.description_en: System startup took too long
items.recommended_action: 优化启动项并检查系统性能
items.recommended_action_en: Optimize startup items and check system performance

commands.name: 查看启动项
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand | Select-Object Name, Command, Location, User

commands.name: 打开任务管理器启动项

items.name: 系统还原失败
items.description: 系统还原操作失败
items.description_en: System restore operation failed
items.recommended_action: 尝试不同的还原点并检查磁盘空间
items.recommended_action_en: Try different restore point and check disk space

commands.name: 查看可用的还原点
commands.command: Get-ComputerRestorePoint | Format-Table SequenceNumber, Description, CreationTime, EventType -AutoSize

commands.name: 检查系统还原服务状态
commands.command: Get-Service -Name srservice, swprv | Format-Table Name, Status, StartType -AutoSize

items.name: 意外关机事件记录
items.description: 上一次系统关机未经正常流程，事件日志服务记录了意外关机。
items.description_en: The previous system shutdown was unexpected; the Event Log service recorded an unexpected shutdown.
causes: 硬件故障导致瞬间断电
causes_en: Hardware failure causing sudden power loss
System hang followed by hard reset
solutions: 查看关机前后的系统与应用日志
配置 UPS 不间断电源
检查电源管理与快速启动设置
审查近期驱动或固件更新
solutions_en: Review system and application logs around shutdown time
Check power management and Fast Startup settings
Review recent driver or firmware updates
items.recommended_action: 排查意外关机根因并加固供电
items.recommended_action_en: Investigate root cause of unexpected shutdown and harden power supply

items.name: 事件日志服务启动
items.description: 事件日志服务已启动，通常表示系统完成启动。
items.description_en: The Event Log service has started, typically indicating system boot completion.
solutions: 确认启动时间是否符合预期
审查启动相关服务依赖
solutions_en: Combine with 6006/6008 to determine shutdown method
items.recommended_action: 记录正常启动基线用于异常比对
items.recommended_action_en: Record normal boot baseline for anomaly comparison

commands.name: 查询事件日志服务启动记录
commands.name_en: Query Event Log Service Start Records

items.name: 事件日志服务停止
items.description: 事件日志服务已停止，通常表示系统正常关机流程启动。
items.description_en: The Event Log service has stopped, typically indicating a normal shutdown process has begun.
causes: 事件日志服务被手动停止
solutions: 排查未正常配对的时间窗口
审查服务停止是否预期
确保事件日志服务不被第三方禁用
solutions_en: Review whether service stop was expected
Ensure Event Log service is not disabled by third parties
items.recommended_action: 核对关机/启动事件配对
items.recommended_action_en: Verify shutdown/startup event pairing

commands.name: 查询事件日志停止记录
检查事件日志服务状态

items.name: 用户或进程触发关机/重启
items.description: 用户或应用程序主动发起关机或重启请求。
items.description_en: A user or application initiated a shutdown or restart request.
solutions: 排查异常进程触发关机
items.recommended_action: 审计所有主动关机/重启操作
items.recommended_action_en: Audit all user/process initiated shutdown/restart operations

commands.name: 查询用户触发关机事件

items.name: 系统冻结/挂起无响应
items.description: 系统无响应并冻结，可能因硬件或驱动死锁导致，未生成标准蓝屏转储。
items.description_en: The system became unresponsive and froze, possibly due to hardware or driver deadlock, without generating a standard blue screen dump.
solutions: 更新显卡与芯片组驱动
启用驱动验证程序定位故障驱动
solutions_en: Enable Driver Verifier to locate faulty driver
items.recommended_action: 排查硬件与驱动死锁根因
items.recommended_action_en: Investigate hardware and driver deadlock root cause

commands.name: 查看系统冻结时段事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Level=1,2} -MaxEvents 50 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, ProviderName, LevelDisplayName -AutoSize

commands.name: 运行内存诊断
commands.pre_check: Write-Warning 'mdsched.exe将调度下次重启进入内存诊断模式，请先保存所有工作'; $true

items.name: 启动修复触发
items.description: 系统启动失败并自动进入启动修复环境尝试恢复。
items.description_en: System boot failed and automatically entered Startup Repair to attempt recovery.
causes: 近期更新或驱动安装失败
causes_en: Failed recent update or driver installation
solutions: 运行启动修复自动修复
必要时从系统还原点恢复
solutions_en: Run sfc and DISM to repair system
Restore from system restore point if needed
items.recommended_action: 修复引导并恢复系统启动
items.recommended_action_en: Repair boot and restore system startup

items.name: 从休眠/睡眠恢复失败
items.description: 系统从睡眠或休眠状态恢复时出现异常或恢复失败。
items.description_en: The system experienced issues or failed to resume from sleep or hibernation state.
causes: 设备驱动不支持电源管理
causes_en: Device driver does not support power management
solutions: 更新显卡与芯片组驱动
检查设备电源管理唤醒权限
solutions_en: Check device power management wake permissions
Use powercfg to troubleshoot wake source
items.recommended_action: 排查电源管理与驱动恢复问题
items.recommended_action_en: Investigate power management and driver resume issues

items.name: 系统文件损坏检测
items.description: 系统文件完整性受损，可能导致功能异常或不稳定。
items.description_en: System file integrity is compromised, which may cause malfunction or instability.
causes: 强制关机导致文件系统损坏
恶意软件篡改系统文件
第三方软件替换系统文件
causes_en: File system corruption from forced shutdown
solutions: 必要时执行就地修复安装
solutions_en: Perform in-place repair install if necessary
items.recommended_action: 立即修复受损系统文件
items.recommended_action_en: Immediately repair corrupted system files

items.name: 磁盘坏扇区错误
items.description: 磁盘出现坏扇区，读写时发生CRC校验错误，可能导致数据丢失。
items.description_en: The disk has bad sectors; CRC errors occurred during read/write, which may lead to data loss.
causes: 磁盘老化出现物理坏道
异常断电导致逻辑坏块
causes_en: Disk aging with physical bad sectors
Logical bad blocks from abnormal power loss
items.recommended_action: 立即备份并修复磁盘错误
items.recommended_action_en: Immediately back up and repair disk errors

commands.name: 查询磁盘SMART状态
commands.command: Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object DeviceId, FriendlyName, MediaType, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus

items.name: 内存转储生成失败
items.description: 系统崩溃后尝试生成内存转储文件失败，无法进行事后分析。
items.description_en: Memory dump file generation failed after a system crash, preventing post-mortem analysis.
causes: 页面文件配置过小或禁用
causes_en: Page file too small or disabled
Page file not on system drive
solutions: 配置系统盘页面文件至少为物理内存大小
设置转储类型为自动或内核转储
确保系统盘有足够空间
solutions_en: Configure system drive page file at least equal to physical memory
Set dump type to Automatic or Kernel dump
Ensure sufficient space on system drive
items.recommended_action: 配置正确的转储与页面文件设置
items.recommended_action_en: Configure correct dump and page file settings

commands.name: 查看页面文件配置
commands.command: Get-CimInstance -ClassName Win32_PageFile | Select-Object Name, FileSize, InitialSize

items.name: 驱动IRQL蓝屏(DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL)
items.description: 驱动程序在错误的IRQL级别访问了分页内存，触发DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL(0xD1)蓝屏。
items.description_en: A driver accessed paged memory at an incorrect IRQL, triggering a DRIVER_IRQL_NOT_LESS_OR_EQUAL (0xD1) blue screen.
causes: 杀毒软件过滤驱动冲突
solutions: 分析转储文件定位故障驱动模块
暂时禁用第三方杀毒过滤驱动
使用驱动验证程序压力测试
solutions_en: Analyze dump file to locate faulty driver module
Update or roll back related driver
Temporarily disable third-party antivirus filter driver
Use Driver Verifier for stress testing
items.recommended_action: 通过转储分析定位并更新故障驱动
items.recommended_action_en: Locate and update faulty driver via dump analysis

commands.name: 配置驱动验证程序
commands.pre_check: Write-Warning 'Driver Verifier配置后下次启动生效，可能导致蓝屏循环。请确认有安全模式访问途径和系统还原点'; $true

items.name: 系统可靠性评分下降
items.description: 系统可靠性监视器评分持续下降，表明近期频繁发生应用崩溃、硬件故障或系统问题。
items.description_en: The Reliability Monitor score is declining, indicating frequent application crashes, hardware failures, or system issues recently.
solutions: 打开可靠性监视器查看时间线
汇总近期所有错误事件分类
针对最高频问题优先处理
solutions_en: Open Reliability Monitor to view timeline
Aggregate and categorize recent error events
items.recommended_action: 全面审查可靠性下降原因
items.recommended_action_en: Comprehensively review causes of reliability decline

commands.name: 查询近期关键错误
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; Level=1,2; StartTime=(Get-Date).AddDays(-7)} | Group-Object Id | Sort-Object Count -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Count, Name

items.name: 系统时间同步失败
items.description: Windows时间服务无法与时间源同步，系统时间可能不准确，影响Kerberos等依赖时间的服务。
items.description_en: The Windows Time service cannot sync with a time source; system time may be inaccurate, affecting time-dependent services like Kerberos.
solutions: 域环境检查PDC模拟器时间源
solutions_en: Check PDC emulator time source in domain
items.recommended_action: 恢复系统时间同步
items.recommended_action_en: Restore system time synchronization

items.name: 启动配置数据(BCD)损坏
items.description: 启动配置数据(BCD)存储损坏，系统无法找到或加载Windows启动管理器。
items.description_en: The Boot Configuration Data (BCD) store is corrupted; the system cannot find or load the Windows boot manager.
items.recommended_action: 从恢复介质重建引导配置
items.recommended_action_en: Rebuild boot configuration from recovery media

items.name: 应用程序阻止系统关机
items.description: 应用程序无响应阻止系统正常关机，导致关机延迟或需要强制结束。
items.description_en: An unresponsive application is blocking normal system shutdown, causing delays or requiring forced termination.
causes_en: Application waiting on network or disk I/O
solutions: 更新或重新安装问题应用
使用组策略设置关机超时
solutions_en: Use Group Policy to set shutdown timeout
items.recommended_action: 定位并解决阻止关机的应用
items.recommended_action_en: Locate and resolve application blocking shutdown

items.name: 服务启动超时
items.description: 服务启动超时，服务未能在规定时间内响应启动请求，可能导致依赖服务连锁失败。
items.description_en: A service timed out during startup, failing to respond to the start request within the timeout period, which may cascade to dependent services.
causes: 服务依赖的资源不可用
solutions: 增加服务超时时间注册表配置
优化启动项减少并发负载
solutions_en: Optimize startup items to reduce concurrent load
items.recommended_action: 调整服务超时并优化启动顺序
items.recommended_action_en: Adjust service timeout and optimize startup order

commands.name: 查询服务超时事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ID=7000,7009,7011} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 系统进入睡眠状态
items.description: 系统因空闲或电源策略进入睡眠状态。
items.description_en: The system entered sleep state due to idle or power policy.
causes: 电源计划配置的空闲超时
causes_en: Idle timeout configured in power plan
solutions: 确认睡眠行为符合电源策略
调整电源计划空闲超时
排查应用程序异常请求睡眠
solutions_en: Confirm sleep behavior matches power policy
items.recommended_action: 审查电源策略与睡眠行为
items.recommended_action_en: Review power policy and sleep behavior

items.name: 显卡驱动超时
items.description: 显卡驱动程序响应超时（TDR超时检测和恢复）
items.description_en: Graphics driver response timeout (TDR Timeout Detection and Recovery)
solutions: 使用 DDU (Display Driver Uninstaller) 在安全模式下彻底卸载旧驱动后重装（DDU 为第三方工具，需手动下载，无对应自动化命令）
通过修改注册表适度增加 TdrDelay 的超时阈值（仅适用于老旧但健康的显卡）
solutions_en: Use DDU (Display Driver Uninstaller) in safe mode to completely uninstall old driver before reinstalling (DDU is a third-party tool requiring manual download, no automated command available)
Moderately increase TdrDelay timeout threshold via registry (only for old but healthy GPUs)
items.recommended_action: 考虑使用DDU彻底清理并重新安装显卡驱动
items.recommended_action_en: Consider using DDU to completely clean and reinstall graphics driver

commands.name: 查看显示适配器信息
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name, DriverVersion, DriverDate

items.name: 设备驱动程序未签名
items.description: 未签名的驱动程序被阻止加载
items.description_en: Unsigned driver was blocked from loading
causes: 使用未签名的驱动程序
系统启用了驱动程序强制签名
solutions: 暂时禁用驱动程序签名强制(不推荐)
solutions_en: Temporarily disable driver signature enforcement (not recommended)
items.recommended_action: 获取并安装签名的驱动程序
items.recommended_action_en: Obtain and install signed driver

commands.name: 查看有问题的驱动程序
commands.command: Get-WindowsDriver -Online | Where-Object {$_.OriginalFileName -like '*unsigned*' -or $_.BootCritical -eq $false} | Select-Object Driver, OriginalFileName, Version, Date

commands.name: 查看驱动程序相关事件

items.name: 外部设备无法识别
items.description: 外部设备无法被系统识别
items.description_en: External device cannot be recognized by the system
solutions: 在其他电脑上测试设备
items.recommended_action: 尝试不同的USB端口并重新安装驱动
items.recommended_action_en: Try different USB port and reinstall driver

commands.name: 查看USB设备
commands.command: Get-PnpDevice -Class USB | Where-Object {$_.Status -ne 'OK'} | Format-Table FriendlyName, Status, InstanceId -AutoSize

commands.name: 查看所有有问题的设备
commands.command: Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object {$_.Status -ne 'OK'} | Format-Table FriendlyName, Status, Class -AutoSize

items.name: BIOS/UEFI更新警告
items.description: 检测到BIOS/UEFI固件可能需要更新
items.description_en: BIOS/UEFI firmware may need update detected
solutions: 检查制造商网站获取BIOS更新
solutions_en: Check manufacturer website for BIOS updates
items.recommended_action: 检查并更新BIOS/UEFI固件
items.recommended_action_en: Check and update BIOS/UEFI firmware

commands.name: 查看BIOS信息
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_BIOS | Select-Object Manufacturer, SMBIOSBIOSVersion, ReleaseDate, SerialNumber

items.name: 磁盘控制器错误
items.description: 磁盘控制器检测到不可恢复的读写错误，可能预示磁盘或线缆故障。
items.description_en: The disk controller detected an unrecoverable read/write error, which may indicate disk or cable failure.
causes_en: Loose or damaged SATA/SAS data cable
solutions: 重新插拔并更换数据线
更新控制器驱动与固件
items.recommended_action: 检查磁盘与控制器硬件状态
items.recommended_action_en: Check disk and controller hardware status

commands.name: 查看物理磁盘健康
commands.command: Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object DeviceId, FriendlyName, HealthStatus, OperationalStatus

items.name: 硬盘SMART预测失败
items.description: 硬盘SMART监测预测即将发生故障，应立即备份数据并更换磁盘。
items.description_en: Disk SMART monitoring predicts imminent failure; back up data immediately and replace the disk.
solutions: 立即备份所有重要数据
solutions_en: Immediately back up all important data

items.description_en: Windows Management Instrumentation (WMI) service encountered an error, potentially affecting system management scripts and monitoring tools.
causes: WMI 提供程序加载失败
WMI 命名空间权限问题
依赖的 RPC 服务不可用
solutions: 验证并修复 WMI 仓库
重新注册 WMI 组件
检查 WMI 命名空间权限
确认 RPC 服务正常运行
solutions_en: Verify and repair the WMI repository
Confirm the RPC service is running normally
items.recommended_action: 验证并修复 WMI 仓库
items.recommended_action_en: Verify and repair the WMI repository

commands.name: 查询 WMI 事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-WMI'} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 修复 WMI 仓库
commands.pre_check: Write-Warning '修复WMI仓库是不可逆操作，可能导致依赖WMI的服务异常'; $true

items.name: 系统还原服务错误
items.description: 系统还原服务在创建还原点或执行还原时遇到错误。
items.description_en: System Restore service encountered an error while creating a restore point or performing a restore.
causes: 系统还原被组策略禁用
causes_en: System Restore disabled by Group Policy
solutions: 确认 VSS 服务正在运行
检查系统还原是否被禁用
solutions_en: Confirm the VSS service is running
Check if System Restore is disabled
items.recommended_action: 检查 VSS 服务和磁盘空间
items.recommended_action_en: Check VSS service and disk space

items.name: 服务恢复失败
items.description: 服务在失败后未能按恢复策略自动重启，或启动类型被意外修改。
items.description_en: Service failed to auto-restart per recovery policy after failure, or its startup type was unexpectedly modified.
causes: 服务恢复策略未配置或配置不当
服务依赖链中的上游服务未启动
启动类型被安全软件或更新修改
causes_en: Service recovery policy not configured or improperly configured
Upstream service in dependency chain not started
Startup type modified by security software or updates
solutions: 配置服务失败后自动重启的恢复策略
恢复正确的服务启动类型
solutions_en: Configure the service recovery policy to auto-restart on failure
Restore the correct service startup type
items.recommended_action: 配置服务恢复策略并检查启动类型
items.recommended_action_en: Configure service recovery policy and check startup type

commands.name: 查询服务恢复事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ID=7042,7036,7040} -MaxEvents 30 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 配置服务自动重启
commands.command: sc.exe failure Spooler reset= 86400 actions= restart/60000/restart/60000/restart/60000

items.name: USB 设备故障/无法识别
items.description: USB 设备无法正常识别或工作。
items.description_en: USB device not recognized or functioning properly.
causes: USB 选择性暂停设置导致
solutions: 尝试更换 USB 端口（优先使用机箱后部端口）
卸载并重新安装 USB 控制器驱动
禁用 USB 选择性暂停设置
检查设备管理器中的未知设备
solutions_en: Try different USB port (prefer rear panel ports)
Uninstall and reinstall USB controller drivers
Check for unknown devices in Device Manager
items.recommended_action: 检查 USB 端口和设备驱动
items.recommended_action_en: Check USB ports and device drivers

commands.name: 查看 USB 相关事件
禁用 USB 选择性暂停
重新安装 USB 控制器
commands.command: Get-PnpDevice -Class USB -Status 'OK' | Disable-PnpDevice -Confirm:$false; Start-Sleep -Seconds 2; Get-PnpDevice -Class USB -Status 'Disabled' | Enable-PnpDevice -Confirm:$false

items.name: Hyper-V/WSL 虚拟化故障
items.description: Hyper-V 或 WSL 虚拟机无法启动或运行。
items.description_en: Hyper-V or WSL virtual machine failed to start or run.
causes: BIOS 中虚拟化技术未启用
与其他虚拟化软件冲突（VMware/VirtualBox）
causes_en: Virtualization technology not enabled in BIOS
solutions: 进入 BIOS 启用 Intel VT-x 或 AMD-V
启用 Windows 功能中的 Hyper-V 和虚拟机监控程序
关闭 VMware/VirtualBox 的 Hyper-V 模式
增加 WSL2 内存限制
solutions_en: Enable Intel VT-x or AMD-V in BIOS
Enable Hyper-V and Virtual Machine Platform in Windows Features
items.recommended_action: 检查虚拟化设置和资源
items.recommended_action_en: Check virtualization settings and resources

items.name: .NET Runtime 应用程序崩溃
items.description: .NET Framework 应用程序发生严重错误并崩溃。
items.description_en: .NET Framework application encountered fatal error and crashed.
solutions: 运行 .NET Framework 修复工具
重新安装出问题的应用程序
查看事件详情中的异常代码
更新 Windows 到最新版本
solutions_en: Check exception code in event details
items.recommended_action: 修复 .NET Framework 或重新安装应用
items.recommended_action_en: Repair .NET Framework or reinstall application

items.name: 蓝牙设备配对失败
items.description: 蓝牙设备配对或连接失败，可能因驱动问题或设备不兼容。
items.description_en: Bluetooth device pairing or connection failed, possibly due to driver issues or device incompatibility.
causes: 设备已被其他连接占用
items.recommended_action: 更新驱动并重新配对蓝牙设备
items.recommended_action_en: Update drivers and re-pair the Bluetooth device

commands.name: 查询蓝牙事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -LogName 'Microsoft-Windows-Bluetooth-MTPEnum/Operational' -MaxEvents 20 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 查看蓝牙设备
commands.command: Get-PnpDevice -Class Bluetooth | Format-Table Name, Status, InstanceId -AutoSize

items.name: 显示驱动 TDR 超时恢复
items.description: 显示驱动停止响应并已恢复，通常因 GPU 超时（TDR）触发。
items.description_en: Display driver stopped responding and has recovered, usually triggered by GPU timeout (TDR).
causes: GPU 驱动过时或不稳定
solutions: 更新 GPU 驱动到最新版本
检查 GPU 温度和散热
调整 TDR 延迟注册表设置
solutions_en: Update GPU driver to the latest version
items.recommended_action: 更新 GPU 驱动并检查散热
items.recommended_action_en: Update GPU driver and check cooling

commands.name: 查询 TDR 事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='Display'} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 查看显卡信息
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_VideoController | Select-Object Name, DriverVersion, DriverDate | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 即插即用设备枚举错误
items.description: 即插即用设备枚举失败，系统无法为设备加载合适的驱动程序。
items.description_en: Plug and Play device enumeration failed; the system could not load an appropriate driver for the device.
causes: USB 端口或总线供电问题
causes_en: USB port or bus power issue
solutions: 在设备管理器中更新驱动
从制造商网站下载最新驱动
检查 Windows Update 中的可选驱动更新
solutions_en: Update the driver in Device Manager
Download the latest driver from the manufacturer website
Check optional driver updates in Windows Update
items.recommended_action: 安装正确的设备驱动程序
items.recommended_action_en: Install the correct device driver

commands.name: 查看问题设备
commands.command: Get-PnpDevice | Where-Object {$_.Status -ne 'OK'} | Format-Table FriendlyName, Status, Class, InstanceId -AutoSize

items.name: Hyper-V 虚拟机监控程序启动失败
items.description: Hyper-V 虚拟机监控程序未能启动，虚拟化功能将不可用。
items.description_en: Hyper-V hypervisor failed to launch; virtualization features will be unavailable.
causes: BIOS 中 VT-x/AMD-V 未启用
与其他虚拟化软件冲突
solutions: 在 BIOS 中启用虚拟化支持
启用 Hyper-V 平台功能
确认 CPU 支持 SLAT
排查第三方虚拟化软件冲突
items.recommended_action: 启用 BIOS 虚拟化和 Hyper-V 平台
items.recommended_action_en: Enable BIOS virtualization and Hyper-V Platform

commands.name: 检查虚拟化支持
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name, VirtualizationFirmwareEnabled, SecondLevelAddressTranslationExtensions | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 远程桌面会话断开
items.description: 远程桌面会话意外断开，可能因网络中断或服务配置问题。
items.description_en: Remote Desktop session disconnected unexpectedly, possibly due to network interruption or service configuration issues.
causes: 防火墙规则阻止 RDP 端口
solutions: 确认防火墙允许 3389 端口
items.recommended_action: 检查网络并重启 RDP 服务
items.recommended_action_en: Check network and restart RDP service

commands.name: 查询 RDP 会话事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-TerminalServices-LocalSessionManager/Operational'; ID=40,56,24,25} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 重启远程桌面服务
commands.pre_check: Write-Warning '重启TermService将断开所有RDP会话，远程执行将失联'; $true

items.name: Windows 音频服务问题
items.description: Windows 音频服务遇到问题，可能导致声音播放中断或无声。
items.description_en: Windows Audio service encountered an issue, potentially causing sound playback interruption or no audio.
solutions: 重启 Windows Audio 服务
items.recommended_action: 重启音频服务并检查设备
items.recommended_action_en: Restart audio service and check device

commands.name: 查看音频设备
commands.command: Get-PnpDevice -Class AudioEndpoint -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table FriendlyName, Status -AutoSize

commands.name: 查询音频服务事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-Audio'} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 摄像头设备访问失败
items.description: 摄像头设备无法访问或未被系统正确识别。
items.description_en: Camera device cannot be accessed or is not properly recognized by the system.
causes: 隐私设置阻止应用访问
摄像头被其他应用占用
solutions: 检查隐私设置中的摄像头权限
关闭占用摄像头的应用
重新连接或更换 USB 端口
solutions_en: Check camera permissions in privacy settings
items.recommended_action: 检查隐私设置并更新摄像头驱动
items.recommended_action_en: Check privacy settings and update camera driver

commands.name: 查看摄像头设备
commands.command: Get-PnpDevice -Class Camera -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table FriendlyName, Status -AutoSize; Get-PnpDevice -Class Image -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table FriendlyName, Status -AutoSize

items.name: 磁盘 I/O 延迟警告
items.description: 磁盘 I/O 操作超时或重置，可能指示存储子系统的性能或硬件问题。
items.description_en: Disk I/O operation timed out or was reset, potentially indicating storage subsystem performance or hardware issues.
causes: 存储空间不足导致频繁 I/O
causes_en: Insufficient storage space causing frequent I/O
solutions: 检查 SATA/NVMe 物理连接
items.recommended_action: 检查磁盘健康状态和连接
items.recommended_action_en: Check disk health status and connections

commands.name: 查询磁盘事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='disk'} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 检查磁盘健康
commands.command: Get-PhysicalDisk | Select-Object DeviceId, FriendlyName, MediaType, OperationalStatus, HealthStatus | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 虚拟磁盘服务错误
items.description: 虚拟磁盘服务（VDS）在管理存储卷或磁盘时遇到错误。
items.description_en: Virtual Disk Service (VDS) encountered an error while managing storage volumes or disks.
causes: VDS 提供程序加载失败
存储控制器驱动不兼容
solutions: 重新注册 VDS 提供程序
检查磁盘管理器中的磁盘状态
solutions_en: Check disk status in Disk Management
items.recommended_action: 重启 VDS 并检查磁盘状态
items.recommended_action_en: Restart VDS and check disk status

commands.name: 查看磁盘状态
commands.command: Get-Disk | Select-Object Number, FriendlyName, OperationalStatus, HealthStatus, BusType | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: TPM 设备问题
items.description: TPM（可信平台模块）设备未就绪或遇到问题，可能影响 BitLocker 和安全启动。
items.description_en: TPM (Trusted Platform Module) device is not ready or encountered an issue, potentially affecting BitLocker and Secure Boot.
causes: TPM 在 BIOS 中被禁用
TPM 与操作系统版本不兼容
solutions: 在 BIOS 中启用 TPM
清除并重新初始化 TPM
确认 Windows 版本支持当前 TPM
solutions_en: Confirm Windows version supports the current TPM
items.recommended_action: 启用并初始化 TPM 设备
items.recommended_action_en: Enable and initialize the TPM device

commands.name: 查看 TPM 状态
commands.command: Get-Tpm | Select-Object TpmPresent, TpmReady, TpmEnabled, TpmActivated | Format-List

commands.name: 查询 TPM 事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-TPM-WMI'} -MaxEvents 20 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 可移动存储设备意外移除
items.description: 可移动存储设备在未安全弹出时被意外移除，可能导致数据损坏。
items.description_en: Removable storage device was unexpectedly removed without safe ejection, potentially causing data corruption.
causes: 供电不足导致设备掉线
驱动故障导致设备重置
causes_en: Power supply insufficient causing device dropout
solutions: 始终使用安全弹出功能
检查 USB 连接和供电
更新 USB 控制器驱动
启用写入缓存策略优化
solutions_en: Always use the safe eject function
Check USB connection and power supply
items.recommended_action: 使用安全弹出并检查 USB 连接
items.recommended_action_en: Use safe eject and check USB connection

commands.name: 查看可移动磁盘
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_DiskDrive | Where-Object {$_.InterfaceType -eq 'USB' -or $_.MediaType -like '*Removable*'} | Select-Object Model, Size, InterfaceType | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: WSL2 发行版启动失败
items.description: WSL2 Linux 发行版启动失败，可能因虚拟机平台或内核问题。
items.description_en: WSL2 Linux distribution failed to launch, possibly due to virtual machine platform or kernel issues.
causes: 虚拟机平台功能未启用
内存不足无法启动虚拟机
causes_en: Virtual Machine Platform feature not enabled
Insufficient memory to start virtual machine
solutions: 重新安装 WSL 发行版
items.recommended_action: 更新 WSL2 内核并检查虚拟机平台
items.recommended_action_en: Update WSL2 kernel and check Virtual Machine Platform

items.name: TLS/SSL 安全协议错误
items.description: TLS/SSL 连接失败或证书验证错误。
items.description_en: TLS/SSL connection failed or certificate validation error.
causes: 中间人攻击或网络拦截
items.recommended_action: 检查证书和 TLS 配置
items.recommended_action_en: Check certificate and TLS configuration

commands.name: 启用 TLS 1.2
commands.command: try { New-Item 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2\Server' -Force -ErrorAction Stop; New-Item 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2\Client' -Force -ErrorAction Stop; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2\Server' 'Enabled' -Value 1 -ErrorAction Stop; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2\Server' 'DisabledByDefault' -Value 0 -ErrorAction Stop; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2\Client' 'Enabled' -Value 1 -ErrorAction Stop; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2\Client' 'DisabledByDefault' -Value 0 -ErrorAction Stop } catch { throw }
commands.rollback_command: Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2\Server' 'Enabled' -Value 0 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Set-ItemProperty 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2\Client' 'Enabled' -Value 0 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; Remove-Item 'HKLM:\SYSTEM\CurrentControlSet\Control\SecurityProviders\SCHANNEL\Protocols\TLS 1.2' -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue

items.name: Windows 时间同步失败
items.description: 系统时间无法与时间服务器同步。
items.description_en: System time failed to synchronize with time server.
causes: 防火墙阻止 NTP 端口 123
solutions: 启动 Windows Time 服务
更换 NTP 服务器（如 time.windows.com）
items.recommended_action: 检查时间服务和网络
items.recommended_action_en: Check time service and network

commands.name: 查看时间服务状态
commands.command: Get-Service w32time | Select-Object Name, Status, StartType

items.name: Defender 实时保护被禁用
items.description: Windows Defender 实时保护被关闭，系统面临安全风险。
items.description_en: Windows Defender real-time protection was turned off, exposing the system to security risks.
causes: 用户手动关闭实时保护
恶意软件关闭安全防护
solutions: 卸载冲突的第三方安全软件
检查组策略中的 Defender 配置
运行全系统恶意软件扫描
solutions_en: Check Defender configuration in Group Policy
Run a full system malware scan
items.recommended_action: 立即重新启用 Defender 实时保护
items.recommended_action_en: Immediately re-enable Defender real-time protection

commands.name: 查看 Defender 状态
commands.command: Get-MpComputerStatus | Select-Object RealTimeProtectionEnabled, AntivirusEnabled, AntispywareEnabled, AMServiceEnabled | Format-List

items.name: Windows 防火墙配置变更
items.description: Windows 防火墙规则被创建、修改或删除。
items.description_en: A Windows Firewall rule was created, modified, or deleted.
causes: 管理员有意修改防火墙规则
应用程序安装时添加规则
组策略推送防火墙配置
恶意软件篡改防火墙设置
solutions: 审查变更的防火墙规则
确认变更来源是否可信
导出当前防火墙配置作为基线
solutions_en: Confirm whether the change source is trusted
Export the current firewall configuration as a baseline
items.recommended_action: 审查防火墙规则变更并确认来源
items.recommended_action_en: Review firewall rule changes and confirm the source

commands.name: 查询防火墙事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Windows Firewall With Advanced Security/Firewall'; ID=2003,2004,2009,2010} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 查看防火墙规则
commands.command: Get-NetFirewallRule | Where-Object {$_.Enabled -eq 'True'} | Select-Object DisplayName, Direction, Action, Profile | Format-Table -AutoSize

commands.name: 查看防火墙状态
commands.command: Get-NetFirewallProfile | Select-Object Name, Enabled, DefaultInboundAction, DefaultOutboundAction | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: Schannel 证书验证失败
items.description: Schannel 在验证服务器或客户端证书时失败，TLS 连接被拒绝。
items.description_en: Schannel failed to validate the server or client certificate; the TLS connection was rejected.
solutions: 更新受信任的根证书列表
检查证书有效期和吊销状态
确认证书主体名称匹配
排查 CRL/OCSP 网络可达性
solutions_en: Update the trusted root certificate list
Check certificate validity and revocation status
items.recommended_action: 更新根证书并检查证书链
items.recommended_action_en: Update root certificates and check the certificate chain

commands.name: 查询 Schannel 事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ProviderName='Schannel'; Level=2} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

items.name: Kerberos 通信错误
items.description: Kerberos 身份验证遇到通信错误，可能影响域登录和资源访问。
items.description_en: Kerberos authentication encountered a communication error, potentially affecting domain login and resource access.
causes_en: System time out of sync with domain
solutions: 确认域控制器网络可达性
同步系统时间与域时间
清除 Kerberos 票据缓存
solutions_en: Sync system time with domain time
items.recommended_action: 检查域控连通性并同步时间
items.recommended_action_en: Check DC connectivity and sync time

items.name: Defender 扫描失败
items.description: Windows Defender 扫描过程中遇到错误，可能未能完全检测或清除威胁。
items.description_en: Windows Defender encountered an error during scanning, possibly failing to fully detect or remove threats.
items.recommended_action: 更新定义并重新扫描
items.recommended_action_en: Update definitions and re-scan

commands.name: 查看威胁历史
commands.command: Get-MpThreatDetection | Select-Object ActionSuccess, Resources, InitialDetectionTime | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 加密文件系统 EFS 错误
items.description: 加密文件系统（EFS）在加密或解密文件时遇到错误。
items.description_en: Encrypting File System (EFS) encountered an error while encrypting or decrypting files.
solutions: 恢复或创建新的 EFS 证书
检查 DPAPI 主密钥状态
重启 EFS 相关服务
solutions_en: Recover or create a new EFS certificate
items.recommended_action: 恢复 EFS 证书并检查 DPAPI
items.recommended_action_en: Recover EFS certificate and check DPAPI

commands.name: 查询 EFS 事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-EFS'} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 查看 EFS 证书

items.recommended_action_en: Streamline startup items and enable Fast Startup

commands.name: 查询启动性能事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Diagnostics-Performance/Operational'; ID=100} -MaxEvents 10 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 查看启动项
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_StartupCommand | Select-Object Name, Command, Location | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 关机缓慢
items.description: 系统关机耗时超过阈值，通常由服务或进程拒绝退出导致。
items.description_en: System shutdown duration exceeds threshold, usually caused by services or processes refusing to exit.
solutions: 审查关机脚本与组策略
使用加速关机注册表调整
solutions_en: Review shutdown scripts and group policy
Use registry tweaks to accelerate shutdown
items.recommended_action: 排查阻塞关机的服务并调整超时
items.recommended_action_en: Investigate services blocking shutdown and adjust timeouts

commands.name: 查询关机性能事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Microsoft-Windows-Diagnostics-Performance/Operational'; ID=200} -MaxEvents 10 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 应用程序挂起
items.description: 应用程序停止响应，被 Windows 错误报告标记为挂起。
items.description_en: An application stopped responding and was flagged as hung by Windows Error Reporting.
causes: 等待网络或磁盘 I/O 超时
items.recommended_action: 分析挂起转储并更新应用
items.recommended_action_en: Analyze hang dump and update the application

commands.name: 查看未响应进程
commands.command: Get-Process | Where-Object {$_.Responding -eq $false} | Select-Object Name, Id, MainWindowTitle | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 磁盘碎片化严重
items.description: 机械磁盘碎片化程度较高，影响读写性能。SSD 应使用 TRIM 而非碎片整理。
items.description_en: Mechanical disk fragmentation is high, affecting read/write performance. SSDs should use TRIM rather than defragmentation.
solutions: 对 HDD 运行碎片整理
对 SSD 运行 TRIM 优化
保留至少 15% 可用空间
将频繁变动的文件迁移到 SSD
solutions_en: Move frequently changing files to SSD
items.recommended_action: 按介质类型执行碎片整理或 TRIM
items.recommended_action_en: Run defragmentation or TRIM based on media type

items.name: WMI 性能问题
items.description: WMI 查询响应缓慢或超时，可能导致依赖 WMI 的监控与管理工具异常。
items.description_en: WMI queries are slow or timing out, which may cause monitoring and management tools that depend on WMI to malfunction.
causes: 第三方 WMI Provider 泄漏
大量并发 WMI 查询
注册表与 WMI 命名空间不一致
causes_en: Large number of concurrent WMI queries
solutions: 优化 WMI 查询语句
调整 WMI 内存上限
items.recommended_action: 重建 WMI 仓库并优化查询
items.recommended_action_en: Rebuild WMI repository and optimize queries

commands.name: 查询WMI事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='Application'; ProviderName='Microsoft-Windows-WMI'} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, LevelDisplayName, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 系统响应缓慢
items.description: 系统整体响应缓慢，用户感知明显延迟，可能由多种资源争用导致。
items.description_en: Overall system response is slow with noticeable user-perceived delay, possibly caused by multiple resource contentions.
causes_en: CPU, memory, or disk resource contention
solutions: 使用性能监视器定位瓶颈
清理启动项与后台任务
运行 sfc /scannow 修复系统
solutions_en: Use Performance Monitor to locate bottleneck
Clean up startup items and background tasks
items.recommended_action: 定位资源瓶颈并优化启动项
items.recommended_action_en: Locate resource bottleneck and optimize startup items

commands.name: 查看系统资源概览
commands.command: Get-Counter '\Processor(_Total)\% Processor Time', '\Memory\Available MBytes', '\PhysicalDisk(_Total)\% Disk Time' -SampleInterval 2 -MaxSamples 3

items.name: 网络延迟过高
items.description: 网络往返延迟过高，导致远程访问、文件共享和在线应用体验下降。
items.description_en: Network round-trip latency is too high, degrading remote access, file sharing, and online application experience.
solutions: 使用 ping 与 tracert 定位延迟节点
solutions_en: Use ping and tracert to locate latency nodes
items.recommended_action: 定位延迟节点并优化路由与 DNS
items.recommended_action_en: Locate latency nodes and optimize routing and DNS

items.name: CPU 节流导致性能下降
items.description: CPU 因散热或电源策略被降频节流，导致计算性能下降。
items.description_en: CPU frequency is throttled due to thermal or power policy, causing reduced computing performance.
causes: 散热不良导致温度墙触发
电源计划设置为节能模式
电池电量不足触发降频
causes_en: Power plan set to Power Saver mode
solutions: 切换到高性能或平衡电源计划
更新 BIOS 与芯片组驱动
在电源选项中关闭处理器降频
solutions_en: Switch to High Performance or Balanced power plan
Disable processor frequency reduction in power options
items.recommended_action: 切换电源计划并改善散热
items.recommended_action_en: Switch power plan and improve cooling

commands.name: 查询CPU频率
commands.command: Get-CimInstance Win32_Processor | Select-Object Name, MaxClockSpeed, CurrentClockSpeed | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 服务启动超时
items.description: 服务在规定时间内未成功启动，可能因依赖服务或资源加载缓慢。
items.description_en: A service failed to start within the timeout period, possibly due to slow dependency services or resource loading.
causes: 服务可执行文件加载缓慢
权限不足导致初始化失败
solutions: 调整服务启动类型为自动（延迟）
查看服务详细错误日志
solutions_en: Change service startup type to Automatic (Delayed)
items.recommended_action: 审查服务依赖并调整启动类型
items.recommended_action_en: Review service dependencies and adjust startup type

commands.name: 查询服务超时事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ID=7000,7009,7011} -MaxEvents 20 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

commands.name: 查看服务依赖
commands.command: Get-Service | Where-Object {$_.Status -ne 'Running'} | Select-Object Name, DisplayName, StartType, DependentServices | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 内存压力过大
items.description: 系统可用内存持续处于低位，触发频繁的页面交换，导致整体性能下降。
items.description_en: Available system memory remains persistently low, triggering frequent paging and degrading overall performance.
solutions: 关闭不必要的服务与应用
items.recommended_action: 关闭内存大户并评估扩容
items.recommended_action_en: Close top memory consumers and evaluate capacity expansion

commands.name: 采样内存计数器
commands.command: Get-Counter '\Memory\Available MBytes', '\Memory\Pages/sec', '\Memory\% Committed Bytes In Use' -SampleInterval 2 -MaxSamples 5

commands.name: 查看内存大户
commands.command: Get-Process | Sort-Object WorkingSet -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 Name, Id, @{N='WS(MB)';E={[math]::Round($_.WorkingSet/1MB,1)}} | Format-Table -AutoSize

items.name: 磁盘队列长度过高
items.description: 磁盘当前队列长度持续高于磁盘可处理能力，表明 I/O 已成为系统瓶颈。
items.description_en: The current disk queue length persistently exceeds the disk's handling capacity, indicating I/O has become a system bottleneck.
causes: 备份或索引任务与业务争用
causes_en: Large number of concurrent read/write requests
Backup or indexing tasks contending with business I/O
solutions: 将高 I/O 任务调度到空闲时段
分离页面文件到独立磁盘
增加内存减少页面交换
solutions_en: Schedule high I/O tasks during idle periods
Separate page file to a dedicated disk
items.recommended_action: 分离 I/O 负载并升级存储
items.recommended_action_en: Separate I/O workloads and upgrade storage

commands.name: 采样磁盘队列计数器
commands.command: Get-Counter '\PhysicalDisk(*)\Current Disk Queue Length', '\PhysicalDisk(*)\Avg. Disk Queue Length' -SampleInterval 2 -MaxSamples 5

items.name: 系统挂起无响应
items.description: 系统完全无响应，只能通过硬重置恢复，可能由内核死锁或驱动挂起引起。
items.description_en: The system becomes completely unresponsive and can only be recovered via hard reset, possibly due to kernel deadlock or driver hang.
solutions: 禁用可疑的电源管理功能
items.recommended_action: 分析转储并更新驱动与固件
items.recommended_action_en: Analyze dump and update drivers and firmware

commands.name: 查询挂起相关事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ID=41,6008} -MaxEvents 10 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, ProviderName, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 注册表膨胀导致性能下降
items.description: 注册表配置单元过大，占用大量内存并降低注册表访问性能。
items.description_en: Registry hives are oversized, consuming significant memory and degrading registry access performance.
causes: 长期安装卸载软件累积
solutions: 卸载不用的应用与驱动
solutions_en: Rebuild the system for a thorough reset
items.recommended_action: 清理残留注册表项并压缩配置单元
items.recommended_action_en: Clean residual registry entries and compress hives

commands.name: 查看注册表配置单元大小
查询资源耗尽事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ID=333} -MaxEvents 10 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 事件日志文件过大
items.description: 事件日志达到最大大小限制，可能丢失重要日志或影响日志查询性能。
items.description_en: An event log has reached its maximum size limit, which may cause loss of important logs or degrade log query performance.
causes: 日志最大大小设置过小
日志保留策略为按需覆盖
高频事件快速填充日志
causes_en: Log maximum size set too small
Log retention policy set to overwrite as needed
High-frequency events rapidly filling the log
solutions: 关闭不必要的详细日志
定期备份并清理旧日志
solutions_en: Regularly back up and clear old logs
items.recommended_action: 调整日志大小上限与保留策略
items.recommended_action_en: Adjust log size limit and retention policy

commands.name: 查看事件日志大小
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -ListLog 'System','Application','Security' | Where-Object {$_.FileSize -gt 0} | Select-Object LogName, @{N='SizeMB';E={[math]::Round($_.FileSize/1MB,1)}}, MaximumSizeInBytes | Sort-Object SizeMB -Descending | Select-Object -First 10 | Format-Table -AutoSize

commands.name: 查询日志已满事件
commands.command: Get-WinEvent -FilterHashtable @{LogName='System'; ID=1105} -MaxEvents 10 | Format-Table TimeCreated, Id, Message -AutoSize

items.name: 电源计划导致性能下降
items.description: 当前电源计划过于侧重节能，导致处理器与设备性能被限制。
items.description_en: The current power plan focuses too much on energy saving, limiting processor and device performance.
causes: 电源计划设为节能模式
causes_en: Power plan set to Power Saver mode
Hard disk sleep timeout too short
solutions: 切换到平衡或高性能电源计划
关闭 USB 选择性暂停
提高处理器最小状态百分比
solutions_en: Switch to Balanced or High Performance power plan
items.recommended_action: 切换到平衡或高性能电源计划
items.recommended_action_en: Switch to Balanced or High Performance power plan

commands.name: 切换到高性能电源计划
commands.name_en: Switch to High Performance Power Plan
